anonymise-text-before-chatgpt.input: Please rewrite this escalation. Email alex@example.com about the delayed delivery; the customer needs an update today.
anonymise-text-before-chatgpt.output: Please rewrite this escalation. Email [Email 1] about the delayed delivery; the customer needs an update today.
steps: Remove attachments and unrelated conversation history before pasting.
Run automatic detection, then check the output against the source.
Paste only the reviewed output into your assistant, followed by your rewriting instruction.
anonymise-text-before-chatgpt.limit: A job title, rare event or combination of facts can still identify someone even when direct identifiers are replaced. Remove unnecessary context yourself.

pii-redaction-tool.input: Send the amended invoice to accounts@example.com. The billing dispute concerns a duplicate charge.
pii-redaction-tool.output: Send the amended invoice to [Email 1]. The billing dispute concerns a duplicate charge.
steps: Choose the smallest excerpt needed by the recipient.
Use automatic mode, or select the relevant categories in Custom rules.
Check every highlighted token and also look for sensitive values that were not highlighted.
pii-redaction-tool.limit: Detection is not proof that text is anonymous. Unusual names, identifiers and indirect clues can be missed, and ordinary text can be replaced incorrectly.

anonymise-legal-documents.input: Send renewal questions to legal@example.com. This agreement renews automatically unless either party gives 60 days notice.
anonymise-legal-documents.output: Send renewal questions to [Email 1]. This agreement renews automatically unless either party gives 60 days notice.
steps: Extract the clause and only the surrounding definitions required to interpret it.
Replace contacts and identifiers, then compare the notice period and obligations with the original.
Have the responsible reviewer check confidentiality and privilege before external sharing.
anonymise-legal-documents.limit: The tool does not assess privilege or provide legal advice. Dates and references may be commercially important; check replacements before relying on a clause summary.

remove-secrets-from-logs.input: Deploy failed: password=ExampleOnly_42! upstream timeout; retry after backoff.
remove-secrets-from-logs.output: Deploy failed: password=[Secret 1] upstream timeout; retry after backoff.
steps: Use a minimal failing log excerpt, not a full environment dump.
Keep secret detection enabled and review credentials, connection strings and embedded payloads.
Rotate any real credential already exposed. Redacting a later copy cannot revoke a leaked secret.
remove-secrets-from-logs.limit: Obfuscated, encoded or application-specific credentials may evade detection. Never test with a live password or assume that a clean result means a secret is safe.

medical-note-anonymiser.input: Appointment admin: send the rescheduling instructions to patient@example.com. A follow-up appointment is requested.
medical-note-anonymiser.output: Appointment admin: send the rescheduling instructions to [Email 1]. A follow-up appointment is requested.
steps: Use synthetic text for evaluation. For real records, first confirm that your organisation permits this external processing service.
Submit only the minimum necessary excerpt, excluding unrelated history.
Review indirect identifiers and clinical meaning before any further sharing.
medical-note-anonymiser.limit: This is not a certified clinical de-identification workflow. Removing contacts does not establish compliance or remove re-identification risk from rare conditions and contextual details.

document-redaction-before-ai.input:
Project handover
Questions: team@example.com
The next review covers delivery risks and outstanding actions.
document-redaction-before-ai.output:
Project handover
Questions: [Email 1]
The next review covers delivery risks and outstanding actions.
steps: Upload a .txt file or text-based PDF, or paste the relevant excerpt.
For PDFs, review extracted spacing, columns and page order before clicking sanitise.
Review tokens and export the plain-text result, not the original PDF.
document-redaction-before-ai.limit: PDF uploads extract text; they do not black out or permanently redact the original PDF. Scans need OCR, complex layouts can be misread, and images or document metadata are not sanitised.
